_schema: Generated by Tests/Tools/StageGen (do not hand-edit; change the generator and re-run). Enemies are Hollow echoes of roster heroes (3 in chapter 1, 4 in chapter 2, then 5); level is the lowest (1-200) at which the best of 4 reference teams at the expected level wins 50-70% (last 5 stages of a chapter: 40-55%), or as close as one level step allows. firstClear = 1 h of that stage's idle loot.
